lines: Jay Russell, the Post. The Question Man asks a prescient question each week at an unannounced location.
This week: what do you think about kids riding e-bikes around town?

choices.label: They look fun.
reply: Ella and Evie said the same thing. 'We think they look fun.'

choices.label: Children on motorcycles.
reply: That's what Christina Maybaum told me. 'Essentially it's children on motorcycles.'

choices.label: Helmets, always.

choices.label: I wish they'd slow down.
reply: Judy Sokoloff, word for word. I'll put you down next to her.

lines: If you entered a competitive eating contest, what would you eat?

choices.label: Steak.
reply: A seventh grader told me steak. 'Even when I was little, I could always eat a lot of steak.'

choices.label: Hot chicken pho.
reply: Two third graders, same answer. Great minds.

choices.label: A hundred strawberries.
reply: A third grader told me she could eat a hundred. I believe her. I believe you.

choices.label: Marshmallows.
reply: A man told me he won a marshmallow contest in high school while choking on one.

lines: Last question of the season. What was your first car?

You've been quoted in the Post three times now. That's more than most of the City Council.
I'll find you next week. I always do. Unannounced location.

entries.name: PPD Blue

lines: PPD BLUE. Every week the Piedmont police post a Pick of the Week: the strangest call in town.
There are 11 picks this year, and every one happened somewhere in Piedmont. Find all 11 scenes.
Find one and the next pick goes up. No need to walk back here: your Journal (J) always shows the latest pick.
This week's pick is in your Journal now. Press J.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'Holy buzzcut, Batman.' A bat dive-bombing people. WHERE: Dracena Park, in the dog park just north of Blair's Quarry.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'Found bound hound sound.' A big gray and white dog stuck between two walls. WHERE: Grand Ave, a few houses east of Zubin's.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'How a bus does a wheelie.' A visiting team's bus stuck on three wheels. WHERE: the entrance to Witter Field. Look for a tilted bus.

PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'Just hit it.' Wasps attacking dogs. An officer checks. WHERE: walk straight south from the Brick Maze House to Hampton Rd, then follow Sandringham Rd to an officer and a buzzing hedge.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'Too early for Santa.' People up on a roof in September. WHERE: Linda Ave, south of Soli's house.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'What do teens without ebikes do?' Teens getting cars to honk at them. WHERE: San Carlos Ave, between Magnolia and Oakland Ave, west of the Middle School.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'Can we keep it, pleeease?' A small white dog with no collar at Wildwood Elementary. WHERE: the dog is at the school. His owner is on Wildwood Ave, just east of it.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'Not going to win that one.' An SUV versus a garbage truck. WHERE: Prospect Rd, southeast of Wildwood Elementary.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'Burning Man? No, no, just a road trip.' Somebody packing a beach cruiser at 2 a.m. WHERE: a driveway on Oakland Ave, just north of Havens Elementary.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'Uber Eats or EMT?' A man called an ambulance because he was hungry. WHERE: Highland Ave, outside the Community Hall.
PPD BLUE. PICK OF THE WEEK: 'MHS Falcon Hour during summer?' A 'falcon' in a school cafeteria. WHERE: Piedmont Middle School on Magnolia Ave. Ask the custodian out front.
PPD BLUE. You've seen every Pick of the Week this year. The officers are a little worried about you.

entries.name: Princess Donut
entries.title: Piedmont Center for the Arts

lines: You may approach. Slowly.
I am Princess Donut. Former Grand Champion, current queen of this staircase, and I have one point two million followers.
And you have... broccoli on your head. Fascinating. Is that a choice?
Do not let those dogs near me. The small one looked at me. I felt it.
Mongo would eat you in one bite. Mongo is a dinosaur. Keep up.
Fourteen? Ugh. I was a Grand Champion before I was one. Try harder.

entries.name: Cheddar
entries.title: Captain Holt's dog

lines: A corgi in a tiny police vest. His tag says CHEDDAR.
Cheddar regards you with total professionalism.
Cheddar is not a dog. Cheddar is a detective. He will not be taking questions.
BONE?!
You try to pet Cheddar. He allows it. Once. Do not get comfortable.
